chapter: Second interview: bass, Parker and Miles
title: Bass battles and the best he ever played
summary: He names a San Francisco jam session as his best; Blanton, Slam Stewart and Callender left no competition.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Yeah. You were talking about some of the contests. Do you remember any in particular on bass that stay in your mind?
Yeah, that you were involved in or that you listened to.
Well, the best I ever played was Oscar came to San Francisco with Duke and Vern Ellis (inaudible) jam session.
Oh, I see, yes. Do you remember any times when there were contests, that you were exceptionally good?
No, I wasn't in -- the best ever was Jimmy Blanton, Sam Stuart, Red Calendar (inaudible), just no competition.
You mean in terms of Blanton?
